item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 1:50 PM, 01 November 2026(Sunday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Batangas (Santo Tomas, Tanauan, Lipa, Malvar, Balete, and Mataasnakahoy), Laguna (Calamba, Los Banos, Calauan, Bay, Cabuyao, Nagcarlan, Rizal, Victoria, Liliw, and Pila), Metro Manila (Marikina, Quezon City, Caloocan, Valenzuela, Malabon, and Navotas), Nueva Ecija (Cabiao, Gapan, General Tinio, San Antonio, San Isidro, Aliaga, Bongabon, Cabanatuan, Cuyapo, Gabaldon, General Mamerto Natividad, Guimba, Jaen, Laur, Licab, Llanera, Nampicuan, Palayan, Penaranda, Quezon, Rizal, San Leonardo, Santa Rosa, Santo Domingo, Munoz, Talavera, Talugtug, and Zaragoza), Quezon (Infanta, Panukulan, Polillo, Real, Perez, Alabat, Quezon, Atimonan, Plaridel, Unisan, Gumaca, Agdangan, Padre Burgos, Pitogo, Tagkawayan, Guinayangan, Calauag, Mauban, and Sampaloc), Rizal (Antipolo, Rodriguez, San Mateo, Tanay, Angono, Baras, Binangonan, Cainta, Cardona, Morong, Taytay, and Teresa), Zambales (Santa Cruz, Candelaria, Masinloc, Palauig, Iba, and Botolan), Bulacan, Pampanga, and Tarlac within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Laguna (San Pablo and Alaminos) and Quezon (General Nakar, Tiaong, Dolores, and San Antonio) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
